# `customer_login`

Area: **selfcare** ([all tables](README.md))

The self-care login of a customer (at most one): email, password and the lockout. Never an app_user: it reaches only /self-care/v1 and only its own customer.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `customer_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `email` | `text` | no |  | The sign-in name and where the codes go, lower case (unique whatever the case was typed in). |
| `password_hash` | `text` | yes |  | scrypt hash (the format of app_user.password_hash); NULL until the customer sets a password with the emailed link code. |
| `email_verified_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | When a link code sent to the email was used; a password needs it. |
| `disabled_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Set by an operator: no sign-in, every session revoked. A login is disabled, never deleted. |
| `failed_attempts` | `integer` | no | `0` | Consecutive wrong passwords; a right one resets it, the lockout starts at 10. |
| `locked_until` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | While in the future, sign-in is refused even with the right password. |
| `created_by` | `text` | no |  | The operator who invited the customer, or the signup that created it. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
